grammar.title: 方位词 + 边 for location words
grammar.pattern: direction + 边 (东边/西边/南边/北边/上边/下边/前边/后边/左边/右边/里边/外边)
grammar.explanation: Adding 边 (biān) to a direction or position word makes a full location noun: 左边 ("the left side"), 里边 ("the inside"), 前边 ("the front"). These combine naturally with 在: 商店在右边 ("The store is on the right").

grammar.title: School levels and their students
grammar.explanation: 小学 ("elementary school"), 中学 ("middle school"), and 大学 ("university") each combine with 生 to name a student at that level: 小学生, 中学生, 大学生. 学生 alone is the general word for "student".

sentences.en: I am a primary school student.
He is a middle school student.
